message:
The yen receipt test passes now, and the full `npm test` run is green (18/18).

The change is in `src/payments/receipt.js`. Yen amounts are stored as whole yen, but the shared `formatMoney` helper always divides by 100 and prints two decimals. So a 500 yen charge came out as `¥5.00`. `renderReceipt` now formats JPY as a whole number with the `¥` symbol and sends every other currency through `formatMoney` unchanged.

The root cause is `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`, which doesn't know about zero-decimal currencies. I left it alone because CLAUDE.md limits this task to `src/payments` and its tests. Invoices (`src/invoices/render.js`) and cart totals (`src/cart/total.js`) use the same helper, so they will still show yen wrong. The proper fix is to teach `money.js` about zero-decimal currencies. That needs the owning team or an explicit scope change.

I haven't committed anything.
